# Wonder Pens

> > A Toronto-based specialty retailer offering a curated selection of fountain pens, inks, and writing instruments from premium international brands.

Wonder Pens is a dedicated writing instruments retailer based in Toronto, Canada, specializing in fountain pens, calligraphy supplies, and premium inks. The store carries products from renowned brands like Pilot, Sailor, Kaweco, Lamy, and Pelikan, serving both casual writers and serious enthusiasts.

## Key Topics

- Fountain Pens
- Fountain Pen Ink
- Writing Instruments
- Pen Brands (Pilot, Sailor, Kaweco, Lamy, Pelikan)
- Ink Brands (J. Herbin, Diamine, Rohrer & Klingner)
- Brush Pens
- Calligraphy Pens
- Gel Pens
- Rollerball Pens
- Ballpoint Pens
- Ink Cartridges

- Stationery Shop

- Brand Filters

## Core Collections

- [Wonder Pens: Fountain Pens, Inks, and Paper Store in Toronto, Canada](https://wonderpens.ca): Wonder Pens homepage: Toronto-based fountain pen, ink, and paper retailer
- [Pens](https://wonderpens.ca/collections/pens): Main pen collection featuring multiple brands and pen types
- [Fountain Pens](https://wonderpens.ca/collections/pens-fountain-pens): Fountain pens collection with customizable writing experiences
- [Fountain Pen and Calligraphy Ink](https://wonderpens.ca/collections/ink): Fountain pen and calligraphy inks in various brands and colors

## Pen Types & Categories

- [Ballpoint Pens](https://wonderpens.ca/collections/pens-ballpoint): Ballpoint pen collection from brands like Parker and Fisher Space Pens
- [Gel Pens](https://wonderpens.ca/collections/pens-gel-pens): Gel pen collection from Pilot, Pentel, and Uni-ball
- [Rollerball Pens](https://wonderpens.ca/collections/pens-rollerball): Smooth rollerball pens bridging ballpoints and fountain pens
- [Brush Pens](https://wonderpens.ca/collections/pens-brush-pens): Brush pen collection from Pentel, Pilot, and Zebra
- [Fineliner Pens](https://wonderpens.ca/collections/pens-fineliner): Fine-tip drawing pens for art and detailed writing
- [Sign Pens](https://wonderpens.ca/collections/pens-sign-pen): Sign pens and felt markers from Pilot, Pentel, and Tombow

## Specialty Writing Instruments

- [Calligraphy Pens](https://wonderpens.ca/collections/calligraphy-calligraphy-pens): Calligraphy pens with various nib sizes from premium brands
- [Dip Pens](https://wonderpens.ca/collections/pens-dip-pens): Dip pens and calligraphy nibs from Brause, Mitchell, and others

## Ink Collections

- [Fountain Pen Ink Shop by Colour](https://wonderpens.ca/collections/ink-shop-by-colour): Ink collection organized by color for easy browsing
- [Black Fountain Pen Ink](https://wonderpens.ca/collections/ink-black): Black fountain pen ink cartridges and bottled inks
- [Blue Fountain Pen Ink](https://wonderpens.ca/collections/ink-blue): Blue fountain pen ink collection in various shades
- [Brown Fountain Pen Ink](https://wonderpens.ca/collections/ink-brown): Brown fountain pen inks from Diamine, Esterbrook, and others
- [Burgundy Ink](https://wonderpens.ca/collections/ink-burgundy): Burgundy fountain pen inks from specialty ink brands
- [Green Fountain Pen Ink](https://wonderpens.ca/collections/ink-green): Green fountain pen inks in multiple shades and brands

## Office & Utility Pens

- [Highlighters](https://wonderpens.ca/collections/pens-highlighter): Highlighter markers from major brands like Pilot and Zebra
- [Dry Erase Pens](https://wonderpens.ca/collections/pens-dry-erase-pens): Whiteboard markers and dry erase pens for office use
